text: Ping Me（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：把 DSH 的回合结果和待处理事项推送到手机上的 ntfy。插件监听会话事件，可通知回合完成、审批或提问等待、失败，也可开启运行状态心跳；设置页可选择通知类型、配置 ntfy 服务并发送测试通知。定时自动化任务还能调用 ping_me 在发现问题时发出提醒。适合希望离开电脑时仍能收到 DSH 进度和待办提示的用户。需要 ntfy 服务（默认 ntfy.sh）；受访问控制的服务可配置访问令牌。

Ping Me sends DSH session alerts to a phone through ntfy: completed turns, pending approvals or questions, failures, and optional live status. Its settings page controls alerts. Scheduled automation can use ping_me for problem alerts. An ntfy server is required; access tokens are optional.
想让 DSH 的回复完成或出错时推送到手机。
DSH 等我批准工具或回答问题时，能不能发个手机提醒？
I want phone alerts when a scheduled DSH task finds a problem.
Ping Me 的功能「会话与自动化推送」：把回合完成、审批请求、待回答问题和失败通知发送到配置的 ntfy 服务；可选心跳显示运行状态。定时任务可调用 ping_me 发送问题提醒，设置页还能调整通知开关并发送测试消息。
Ping Me 使用前须知：通知内容发送到配置的 ntfy 服务（默认 ntfy.sh）；访问令牌可选。（见 lib/index.js:119-133、lib/client.js:103-115）

dsh-ping-me README · Introduction：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin that sends **notifications to your phone** through [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh): when a turn is done, when an agent needs your approval or has a question, and when something fails. Start a long task, walk away, and your phone tells you when to come back.

dsh-ping-me README · Introduction：**Automation tasks can alert you, too.** A `ping_me` tool lets an agent run by dsh's Schedule ping you only when it actually found a problem. A daily "all fine" stays quiet.

**Push only.** The plugin publishes and never subscribes. Nothing anyone sends to your topic can ever reach your agents.

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ping-me
```
dsh-ping-me README · Introduction：

dsh-ping-me README · What you get：| Notification | When | Sound |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ **Turn finished**, with the reply | a turn you started is done | normal |
| ✋ **Needs your approval** / ❓ **Has a question** | an approval or `ask_user_question` is waiting; the question and its options are in the notification | loud |
| ❌ **Failed** | error, output limit, policy block. Your own Stop stays silent | high |
| ⚠️ **Automation alert** | an automation task called `ping_me` because it found a problem | high |
| 🟢 **Fix the login bug · running bash · 2m 10s** (optional) | live status while a turn runs, updated in place, then turns into the ✅ result | silent |

dsh-ping-me README · What you get：- **Open dsh button:** every notification has one. It only opens dsh in your browser, and you still need your dsh login. The address is detected from the browser you use dsh in.
- **Labelled by session:** notifications carry the session's title, so you know which agent it is.
- **Subagents stay quiet:** their parent reports.
- **Long replies** are cut to fit ntfy's 4 KB limit and end with "full reply in dsh".

dsh-ping-me README · Install：Into your dsh **web profile** (`web` below is the profile name; use whichever profile backs your web GUI). From a source checkout, use `pnpm dsh` instead of `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh`:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ping-me
```

Restart dsh once, then open **Plugins → dsh-ping-me**. Requires dsh 0.2.0 or newer and Node 20+. There's no build step; the one runtime dependency is [`qrcode`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode), for the QR code.

dsh-ping-me README · Install：**Let your agent guide you:** ask any dsh session to *"help me set up dsh-ping-me"*. The `ping_me` tool points agents to [`SETUP-GUIDE.md`](SETUP-GUIDE.md), a step-by-step script with checks and troubleshooting that ships with the plugin.
dsh-ping-me README · Connect your phone：No account, no password: the plugin makes a random topic for you. Think of a topic as a private radio channel that dsh broadcasts on and your phone listens to.

dsh-ping-me README · Connect your phone：1. Install the free **ntfy** app ([Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.heckel.ntfy), [iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/app/ntfy/id1625396347), [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/io.heckel.ntfy/)).
2. Subscribe to your topic:
   - **Android:** pick **Android** in the card and scan the QR code with your camera. The topic opens in the ntfy app; tap **Subscribe**.
   - **iPhone:** the iPhone app can't be opened by a QR code. In the app tap **+** (top right), enter the topic name from the card, leave **Use another server** off, and tap **Subscribe**.
3. Press **Send test notification**.
dsh-ping-me README · Connect your phone：**Missing notifications on Android?** Allow notifications for ntfy, and set its battery usage to *Unrestricted*.

dsh-ping-me README · Automation tasks：dsh's Schedule posts a prompt into a session at the time you set. Tell it when to ping you:

> Every day at 8:00 Europe/Berlin: check `~/app/logs/backup.log` for the last 24 h. If a backup failed, call `ping_me` with the evidence. If everything is fine, don't ping.

dsh-ping-me README · Automation tasks：- **Only from automation tasks:** `ping_me` works only in turns an automation task started. In a normal chat it refuses, so it can't turn into spam.
- **Hourly cap:** 10 pings by default.
- **Quiet runs:** the reply of an automation run isn't pushed by default, so the daily "all fine" stays quiet. You'll still hear about failures and questions. Switch on *Automation runs finished* to get every run.
- **Log:** every `ping_me` call, sent or refused, is logged to `~/.dsh/ping-me/log.jsonl`.

dsh-ping-me README · For agents: the `ping_me` tool：- **`ping_me({ title, message, urgent? })`:** pushes an alert to the user's phone. `message` can be markdown. `urgent` sets max priority.
- **Root sessions only:** subagents don't get the tool. Schedule delivers to root sessions anyway.
- **Cheap to carry:** the tool definition is about 160 tokens per request, including the pointer to `SETUP-GUIDE.md`.

dsh-ping-me README · Security：- **Push only:** no subscription, no reply handling, no notification buttons that post back. Compare [`dsh-ntfy-remote`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ntfy-remote), which injects anything posted to a session's topic as your command, on a topic derived from the session id.
- **The topic is a secret:** 96 random bits, so nobody can guess it. But anyone who has it can read your notifications, and those can include agent replies. Don't share it; **New topic** in the card replaces it.
- **More privacy:** run your own ntfy server, or use a reserved topic on ntfy.sh. Enter the server and an access token under *Advanced*. The token is kept in dsh's credential store and never shown again.
- **Login required:** the settings routes go through dsh's own `/api` layer (`ctx.connection.fetch`), so only browsers logged in to your dsh can use them.

dsh-ping-me README · Limits：- **ntfy.sh free tier: about 250 messages a day.** Each live-status update costs one, so leave it off on ntfy.sh or use your own server.
- **No "dsh died" alert:** ntfy.sh can't cancel or postpone a delayed message (tested 2026-10-25), so a dead-man alert would fire after every turn. Instead, the live status shows an "Updated HH:MM" time: if it stops moving, dsh stopped.
- **No "stuck" alarm:** model output streams outside the events plugins see, so a model thinking for minutes can't be told apart from a hang.
- **Answer in dsh:** approvals and questions are answered in dsh, not from the phone. That's the price of push only.
dsh-ping-me README · Tested：Verified live with dsh 0.2.1 on Linux, a local 27B model and ntfy.sh, checking every push on the topic:

dsh-ping-me README · Tested：- **Chat turn:** ✅ with the reply, the session title and the Open dsh button.
- **Question:** ❓ loud, with the question and its options.
- **Approval:** ✋ loud, with the tool and the reason, in read-only mode.
- **Automation task:** `schedule_create` → ⚠️ from `ping_me`; the run's own reply correctly not pushed.
- **`ping_me` in a normal chat:** refused and logged, nothing pushed.
- **Live status:** updated in place ("thinking", "running bash"), then turned into the ✅ result.
- **Your own Stop:** nothing pushed, the live status removed.
- **Setup guide:** a fresh session asked to "help me set up dsh-ping-me" found the guide and walked through it step by step.

dsh-ping-me README · Tested：`npm test` runs the notification rules, the `ping_me` refusals and cap, the push-only guarantee, label and address detection, and the settings routes against a fake dsh and a fake ntfy.
